name: causal_pattern_residual_adapter
motivation: Development negative bias and short-gap error of retained temporal model. No test outcome determines parameters or acceptance.
hypothesis: A train-only absolute-error residual learner can expose causal recent-level, freshness and load-change patterns obscured by the joint-state objective.
base: Immutable temporal_only neural checkpoints; no neural retraining.
new_module: mu_corrected = mu_frozen + HGB(raw causal features, mu_frozen, sigma_frozen, causal innovations); point=max(0,mu_corrected).
control: Same HGB limits and rows, with aggregate recent-history and derived innovation feature slots replaced by zero. Same nominal capacity, actual leaves reported; not equal effective capacity.
new_hypothesis_relative_to_rejected_revi: Train-only nonlinear aggregate posterior correction optimized for MAE, not an untrained last-value anchor added to every Gaussian prior mean. The rejected prior-anchor architecture stays rejected.
selection: Average inner house-macro MAE at least 5% below raw frozen proposal and 1% below no-pattern control; inner RMSE no more than 5% above raw proposal. Complete all 3 folds before decision.
substantial_superiority_target: At least 10% lower OOF MAE than strongest completed baseline, reported separately; not promised and never tuned on outer/test.
if_rejected: Preserve all negative search fits. Do not continue seeds/final fitting. NB06 records non-promotion and keeps original frozen results.
if_retained: Fit same fixed full and no-pattern heads for seeds43/101, complete development OOF, then source-only final full heads and retrospective evaluations.
distribution_boundary: This revision initially targets point accuracy. Historical Gaussian covariance/acquisition results cannot be relabelled as results of the corrected head.
observations: Reuse exact audited masked raw inputs; no future/current aggregate measurements, test labels or new energy synthesis. Features contain no house ID, row ID, target, role or scenario metadata.
evaluation_boundary: All previously inspected domains including UK-DALE are retrospective for v03. No new independent-confirmation claim.
novelty_boundary: Residual learning and gradient boosting are known. This experiment can establish a contribution of the module, not mathematical priority.
